name: Landhaus Alpenrose
beschreibung: Landhaus Alpenrose welcomes vacationers to a sunny panoramic high plateau in Hinterthiersee perched above Lake Thiersee in the Kufstein district. This family-run guesthouse is celebrated for its attentive hosting and cozy alpine atmosphere. Tastefully styled in Tyrolean country-house aesthetics, the guest rooms and self-catering apartments feature private balconies framing sweeping views of the Kaisergebirge peaks and alpine meadows. A wholesome breakfast buffet filled with fresh regional farm items provides an energetic start to the day. The location serves as a wonderful springboard for scenic hiking, mountain biking, and relaxed winter sports.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming family guesthouse and holiday apartments in Hinterthiersee overlooking the Kaisergebirge.
